1_keyword.question: Which awards in the subset mention 'machine learning'?

mysql_like.query:
SELECT a.award_id FROM award a JOIN institution i ON i.inst_id = a.inst_id
                   WHERE i.state = %(state)s AND a.end_date >= %(since)s
                     AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%%', %(topic)s, '%%') OR a.abstract LIKE CONCAT('%%', %(topic)s, '%%'))

2_funding_by_year.question: How much funding went to the subset per fiscal year and agency?

mysql.query:
SELECT f.fiscal_year, g.code AS agency, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS awards, SUM(f.amount) AS funding
              FROM award a
              JOIN institution i   ON i.inst_id = a.inst_id
              JOIN award_funding f ON f.award_id = a.award_id
              JOIN agency g        ON g.agency_id = a.agency_id
              WHERE i.state = %(state)s AND a.end_date >= %(since)s AND f.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2026
              GROUP BY f.fiscal_year, g.code
              ORDER BY f.fiscal_year, g.code
mysql.explain_analyze:
-> Group aggregate: count(distinct award.award_id), sum(award_funding.amount)  (actual time=353..367 rows=21 loops=1)
    -> Sort: f.fiscal_year, g.`code`  (actual time=353..355 rows=83501 loops=1)
        -> Stream results  (cost=70548 rows=3215) (actual time=0.0506..336 rows=83501 loops=1)
            -> Nested loop inner join  (cost=70548 rows=3215) (actual time=0.0498..329 rows=83501 loops=1)

                            -> Covering index scan on i using uq_institution  (cost=1760 rows=16633) (actual time=0.0223..1.9 rows=16656 loops=1)

3_coinvestigator_pairs.question: Which pairs of investigators share the most awards in the subset?

mysql.query:
SELECT x.inv_id AS a, y.inv_id AS b, COUNT(*) AS shared
              FROM award_investigator x
              JOIN award_investigator y ON y.award_id = x.award_id AND x.inv_id < y.inv_id
              JOIN award a              ON a.award_id = x.award_id
              JOIN institution i        ON i.inst_id = a.inst_id
              WHERE i.state = %(state)s AND a.end_date >= %(since)s
              GROUP BY x.inv_id, y.inv_id
              ORDER BY shared DESC, a, b
              LIMIT 20

4_update_embedded_investigator.question: An investigator's name changes. What has to be written?

mongo.timing_note: each timed run = rename + rename back (2 updateMany calls)

mysql.update: UPDATE investigator SET full_name = %(name)s WHERE inv_id = %(inv_id)s
mysql.timing_note: each timed run = BEGIN; UPDATE; ROLLBACK (data unchanged)

4_update_embedded_investigator.note: MongoDB has no multi-document atomicity here unless a transaction (replica set) is used; a crash mid-updateMany leaves some documents with the old name. In MySQL the name is stored once (normalized), so every award sees the change through the join.
